description: Form 6251 line 10 adds Schedule 2 line 1z, which includes the excess advance premium tax credit repayment (line 1a). Single 2025: wages $60,000, advance PTC $6,000 against a credit of $900 (8.5% of $60,000 = $5,100 contribution on a $6,000 benchmark), repayment capped at $1,625 (300–400% FPL). Regular tax $5,075. AMTI $260,000 − $88,100 = $171,900 × 26% = $44,694 → AMT $44,694 − ($5,075 + $1,625) = $37,994.
